symptoms: DB connections remain above 92% after deploy
correct_cause: Connection leak on an exception path introduced by deploy v2.4.

symptoms: Nested filter requests return 500 after a parser rollout
CPU rises on all parser replicas
The database and index disk stay healthy
correct_cause: Bad deploy changed nested-facet parser behavior and broke compatibility.

symptoms: Queue lag rises in retry waves
correct_cause: Memory leak from unbounded retained retry envelopes.

symptoms: Certificate expiry passed during renewal delay
correct_cause: Expired Auth Service certificate after the renewal job was deferred.

symptoms: WAL retention grows while archive cleanup stalls
correct_cause: Orphaned replication slot retained WAL until the disk filled.

symptoms: Provider latency spikes are regional and clients retry aggressively
correct_cause: Upstream acquirer timeout amplified by an unbounded retry policy.

symptoms: Read-after-write returns one stale preference field
Only an old cache-version key is affected
correct_cause: Stale preference-cache schema version after a one-time migration.

symptoms: One tenant partition returns duplicate results
correct_cause: Shard replay reused a watermark and emitted the same documents twice.
